precedence: video > SfM > on-site floor guide (topology only; metric fit RMS 7.9-8.1m rejected) > original model > inferred/standard

rules.F1: platform-layer poke <=0.2m through a reconstructed floor -> cut (physically impossible)
rules.F2: occlusion test: registered frames see static SfM points >1.5m beyond the mass at its pixels -> cut
rules.F3: occlusion test: SfM surface within 1m at the mass -> keep
rules.F4: 30deg incline >=5m2 or rises >=8m above floor (column, shaft, core) -> keep
rules.F5: unobserved low mass inside a guide-derived public zone of the reconstruction -> cut (guide over original)
rules.F6: unobserved mass in a purely inferred band (1F u-62..55 v>-6.4 behind the rear shop row; 2F u-30..30 v>4 arcade track fringe) -> keep; reconstruction yields

scans.surface-cap: first hit 0.03-3.1m above reconstructed floor, 0.5m grid
scans.body-occupancy: capsule r0.2 at 0.5-1.8m above floor, original layers only, envelope cells (floor ends within 1m) excluded

occlusion.models: SfM model4 (exact known transform, 90-188s) and model5 (camera-centre similarity, 198-224s)
